message: You know that one friend who always shows up with more snacks than the party needs? Well, that’s me when it comes to fire safety! I’ve got smoke alarms in every room and even a little escape plan sketched out on the fridge. It might seem like overkill, but I’d rather be the gloriously over-prepared one than the panicked neighbor. Plus, it’s kind of fun to have a little plan in place! How do you handle safety at home? Any quirky tips to share?
